name: Heartbeat
desc: Community platform for members, groups, channels, threads, events and courses

actions.name: heartbeat_create_user
actions.description: Create a new user in a Heartbeat community

actions.name: heartbeat_list_users
actions.description: Lists community members, optionally filtered by text, group, role or admin status.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_user
actions.description: Gets one member by user ID, including profile details.

actions.name: heartbeat_find_user_by_email
actions.description: Looks up a member by exact email address.

actions.name: heartbeat_update_user
actions.description: Updates a member's profile, identified by email. Fields left empty stay as they are.

actions.name: heartbeat_remove_user
actions.description: Deactivates a member by email. Their threads, comments and messages stay; Reactivate Member undoes it.

actions.name: heartbeat_reactivate_user
actions.description: Gives a deactivated member access to the community again.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_pending_user
actions.description: Pre-registers a person who becomes a member with this role and groups the first time they log in.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_user_completed_lessons
actions.description: Lists a member's completed course lessons, newest completion first.

actions.name: heartbeat_mark_lessons_completed
actions.description: Adds lessons to a member's completed lessons. Never removes completions.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_roles
actions.description: Lists the roles in the community with their IDs.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_groups
actions.description: Lists the groups in the community.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_group
actions.description: Gets one group with its members.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_group
actions.description: Creates a group, optionally under a parent group and with initial members.

actions.name: heartbeat_update_group
actions.description: Changes a group. Fields left empty stay as they are.

actions.name: heartbeat_delete_group
actions.description: Deletes a group. Members stay in the community.

actions.name: heartbeat_add_users_to_group
actions.description: Adds members to a group by email, optionally moving them out of sibling groups.

actions.name: heartbeat_remove_users_from_group
actions.description: Removes members from a group by email. They stay in the community.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_channels
actions.description: Lists the channels in the community, optionally only one type.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_channel_categories
actions.description: Lists the channel categories (sidebar sections).

actions.name: heartbeat_create_channel_category
actions.description: Creates a channel category (sidebar section).

actions.name: heartbeat_create_channel
actions.description: Creates a posts (threads) or chat channel in a category.

actions.name: heartbeat_update_channel
actions.description: Changes a channel's name, description, read-only setting or who can access it.

actions.name: heartbeat_delete_channel
actions.description: Permanently deletes a channel and all its threads.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_channel_threads
actions.description: Lists threads in a posts channel, newest first, one page at a time.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_thread
actions.description: Gets one thread with its comments and replies.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_thread
actions.description: Posts a new thread in a posts channel.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to a thread, or a reply to a comment.

actions.name: heartbeat_send_chat_message
actions.description: Sends a message to a chat channel.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_chat_messages
actions.description: Lists messages in a chat channel, newest first, one page at a time.

actions.name: heartbeat_send_direct_message
actions.description: Sends a direct message from an admin to a member.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_or_create_direct_chat
actions.description: Returns the direct chat between two users, creating an empty one if none exists.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_direct_messages
actions.description: Lists the 100 most recent messages of a direct chat that includes an admin.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_events
actions.description: Lists community events, optionally for one group or a time range.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_event
actions.description: Gets one event, optionally with the dates of all its occurrences.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_event_attendance
actions.description: Gets who attended the last 10 occurrences of an event.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_event
actions.description: Creates a community event and invites members, groups or outside guests.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_invitations
actions.description: Lists the invitation links with their role and groups.

actions.name: heartbeat_create_invitation_link
actions.description: Creates an invitation link that gives new members a role and groups.

actions.name: heartbeat_add_emails_to_invitation
actions.description: Lets these emails join through an invitation link, optionally emailing them the invitation.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_courses
actions.description: Lists courses with their cohorts, modules and lessons.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_lesson
actions.description: Gets one course lesson with its Markdown content.

actions.name: heartbeat_list_documents
actions.description: Lists the community documents (wiki pages), one page at a time.

actions.name: heartbeat_get_document
actions.description: Gets one community document (wiki page) with its Markdown content.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: heartbeat_new_member
triggers.description: Fires when a new member joins the community. Members added with Create User or Create Member do not fire it.

triggers.name: heartbeat_new_thread
triggers.description: Fires when a new thread is posted, in any channel or one channel.

triggers.name: heartbeat_new_mention
triggers.displayName: New Mention in Thread or Comment
triggers.description: Fires when chosen members or groups are @mentioned in a thread or comment.

triggers.name: heartbeat_new_event
triggers.description: Fires when a new event is created in the community.

triggers.name: heartbeat_new_direct_message
triggers.description: Fires when a chosen admin receives a direct message.
